2609.37446.title: Demistifying Data and Simulator Assumptions in Supervised Causal Discovery
2609.37446.paper_summary: Supervised causal discovery learns to infer causal structure for a new dataset from training datasets paired with structural labels. These training pairs are typically simulated, making the simulator both a source of supervision and a carrier of assumptions about causal graphs, mechanisms, and noise. Understanding the resulting predictions therefore requires examining how these assumptions supplement the information available in observational data, which may be compatible with multiple causal graphs. This paper examines that relationship across representative methods available through June 2026. We organize these methods by prediction target, prediction granularity, encoder, structural decoder, and training regime to relate what each method predicts to how it uses data and simulator-based supervision. Using this framework, we distinguish two questions: whether the target is identifiable under the assumed model class, and whether a trained predictor generalizes beyond its training distribution. Restrictions on mechanisms and noise can make otherwise ambiguous causal directions identifiable, but predictive accuracy under those restrictions does not establish transfer when they change. This distinction motivates evaluation that matches metrics to the identifiable graph target and tests changes in graphs, mechanisms, and noise between training and deployment. Extending such evaluation to real data also requires documenting the external causal evidence and uncertainty behind benchmark reference graphs. Together, these analyses guide method comparison and identify open questions in transfer, test-time adaptation, and uncertainty assessment.
2609.37446.paper_summary_zh: 監督式因果發現學習從配有結構標籤的訓練數據集中推斷新數據集的因果結構。這些訓練對通常是模擬的，使得模擬器既是監督的來源，也是關於因果圖、機制和噪聲假設的載體。因此，理解所產生的預測需要檢視這些假設如何補充觀察數據中可用的信息，而觀察數據可能與多個因果圖相容。本文檢視了這種關係，涵蓋截至2026年6月的代表性方法。我們根據預測目標、預測粒度、編碼器、結構解碼器和訓練制度組織這些方法，以將每種方法的預測與其如何使用數據和基於模擬器的監督相關聯。利用這一框架，我們區分了兩個問題：目標是否在假定的模型類別下是可識別的，以及訓練好的預測器是否能夠超越其訓練分佈進行泛化。對機制和噪聲的限制可以使得原本模糊的因果方向變得可識別，但在這些限制下的預測準確性並不確立當它們改變時的轉移。這一區分促使我們進行評估，使指標與可識別的圖目標相匹配，並測試訓練和部署之間圖、機制和噪聲的變化。將此類評估擴展到真實數據還需要記錄基準參考圖背後的外部因果證據和不確定性。這些分析共同指導方法比較並識別轉移、測試時適應和不確定性評估中的未解問題。
